maya (support): hey team — BrightPath reporting they lost access to model endpoints and billing after last night’s RBAC refactor. customer says console shows "insufficient permissions" and generation API returns 403
adam (BrightPath): confirmed — my org admin can’t view models or invoices. embedding endpoints 403 as well. blocked on demo tomorrow :grimacing:
maya (support): escalated to sec-eng. collecting org id + sample request IDs. @omar can you take a look?
omar (sec-eng): on it. can you paste a failing request ID and a console screenshot? also need SAML assertion sample if possible.
adam (BrightPath): request id: req_4b8f2a1c. screenshot attached. SSO is Ok on our side — we can login but permissions missing.
maya (support): attaching logs:
```
2024-09-02T02:12:34Z INFO auth evaluate principal=org:brightpath:user:adam attributes={role=org-admin, dept=ml} policy=deny reason=missing_binding
2024-09-02T02:12:34Z DEBUG rolesync: attr_map={sso:groups->redwood:role} mapped_role=org-analyst
```
omar (sec-eng): interesting — rolesync map shows group mapping collapsed to org-analyst. looks like the recent role canonicalization job removed custom role bindings for BrightPath and replaced with platform defaults. probable root cause: role-squash job used wrong precedence for tenant-specific bindings.
jess (infra): we ran a batch reconcile last night (deploy-bot: deployment 2024-09-02T01:50). It included role graph migration v2.2.3. Change log: "normalize role names across orgs".
deploy-bot: deployment 2024-09-02T01:50 completed for rolesvc v2.2.3.
li (sre): can we reproduce locally with a test org and same group attributes? if yes we should roll the migration back.
omar (sec-eng): repro steps minimal: create SAML assertion with group X, run rolesync map. mapping currently prefers global templates over tenant overrides. quick mitigation: reapply tenant bindings for BrightPath via admin API.
nora (support-esc): requesting permission to run admin rebind for BrightPath. need approval from Security lead to change role bindings.
maya (support): pinging execs — @omar approve on behalf of sec-eng?
omar (sec-eng): approve. execute rebind and monitor.
jess (infra): I'll prepare a one-off patch to rolesync to add tenant override precedence and schedule an incident rollback if errors spike.
maya (support): running admin rebind now: `POST /admin/orgs/brightpath/rebind` payload `{"bindings": [{"role": "org-admin", "principal": "group:brightpath-admins"}]}`
adam (BrightPath): I see console starting to show models! embedding call returned 200 for req_4b8f2a1c. thanks. :raised_hands:
li (sre): monitoring traces — latency fine, error rate back to baseline.
omar (sec-eng): checking audit logs to confirm only the rebind action occurred:
```
2024-09-02T03:01:12Z AUDIT actor=maya action=rebind target=org:brightpath detail=added_binding role=org-admin principal=group:brightpath-admins
```
maya (support): confirmed access restored for Adam and other admins. following up with BrightPath to validate billing permissions too.
adam (BrightPath): billing page also visible now. invoices load. thanks for the fast turnaround.
omar (sec-eng): root cause summary for incident notes: role canonicalization migration (rolesvc v2.2.3) incorrectly set precedence causing tenant-specific bindings to be overshadowed by global templates. fix: emergency rebind + patch to rolesync precedence logic + scheduled postmortem.
jess (infra): plan: revert migration if patch not merged by EOD; add integration test for tenant override precedence.
nora (support-esc): documenting customer impact and timeline for CSM. will open ticket for compensation discussion if needed.
maya (support): closing loop with BrightPath and scheduling postmortem invite for tomorrow 09:30 UTC. any other blockers?
omar (sec-eng): will open a vuln/bug in tracker: RBAC-2024-091, assign to rolesvc owners, include repro and s3 logs.
li (sre): adding alert to detect sudden drop in tenant-specific bindings.
adam (BrightPath): appreciate the responsiveness. please share the postmortem when ready.
maya (support): will share. marking thread resolved for now. :white_check_mark:
